title: What is Jev AI by TypeSafe?

scenes.narration: Stop using giant LLMs for simple if-statements. TypeSafe AI just launched Jev, a blazing fast System One foundation model.

props.title: Meet Jev: System 1 AI
props.subtitle: High-speed typed decisions that replace slow conversational LLMs

scenes.narration: Instead of slow token-by-token generation, Jev takes your application state and evaluates typed questions in parallel in under 100 milliseconds.
Traditional LLMs are built to chat and often hallucinate formats. Jev acts as an ultra-fast, deterministic decision engine costing fractions of a cent.
In code, define typed primitives like Choice or Noul. You get direct type-safe branching without parsing markdown.
Jev is built for AI agent tool gating, sub-second support routing, content moderation, and high-frequency semantic filtering.
